verdict.rationale: GitLab CI/CD is designed to run headlessly via pipelines (gitlab-docs-8), has a REST/GraphQL API for programmatic interaction (gitlab-docs-10), a documented CLI (gitlab-probe-3), and self-hosted installation options (Linux package, Helm/Operator) enabling fully automated, non-interactive deployments (gitlab-docs-9, gitlab-docs-16). Missing for 10: no direct first-party doc explicitly framing CI pipelines as a headless automation mode for AI agents specifically, and no independent/hands-on report confirming smooth headless CI automation (community evidence instead surfaces CI reliability complaints unrelated to headless capability itself).
